The video tells a fictional story set in Neo Tokyo, where AI bots called persocoms are common, and one special persocom, the chobit, seeks unconditional love from her person.

records.title: Wake Up (feat. Dizzy Wright)
records.creator: 0x78ad590dE27Fe86ddd40CA09f47B3C9eF58FBCB3
records.note:
Growing up I looked up to Dizzy Wright and was highly inspired by his music. I spent years working on music of my own and creating a name for myself. Taught myself how to record vocals and engineer them. After years of writing and releasing music I slowly got better and better at producing my own music. 

Everything being recorded in my bedroom with equipment I saved up for a slowly purchased along my music journey. Over the course of those years I was on a mission to once day get Dizzy Wright on one of my songs. Contacting his management multiple times and sending over song after song trying to make something work. 

After pounding the pavement long enough I found myself working on this song. Getting ready to release it, something felt like it was missing... 

So shooting my shot like any hungry artist would do, I sent the files to Dizzy's team and asked to give it a listen. 

After a couple days I got an email back saying he heard the track and he loved it. I went back to work on the song chopping it up so that there could be an open verse for Dizzy to work with. 

The rest was history. 

This song is proof that no matter who you are or how big your name is, Working hard and staying consistent will pay off. 

Do what you love and dream big

records.title: OCEAN LULLABY
records.creator: 0x4bcaC160CE0Fb9015C2b8C28726cb1EAc879a960
records.note:
Dive into the enchanting embrace of "Ocean Lullaby," a captivating 20 minute sound montage meticulously crafted from original field recordings I captured & processed over the course of 3 years, transcending the boundaries of conventional music composition. This auditory work ventures beyond the realms of traditional music, inviting contemplation with a thought-provoking question: What is music?

Immerse yourself in the gentle cadence of the sea as you embark on an ambient journey spanning three coastal states in America: Florida, Georgia, and South Carolina. "Ocean Lullaby" artfully weaves together a symphony of ocean waves and field recordings, creating an immersive soundscape that captures life on the coast.

For me, this conceptual soundwork challenges conventional notions of music, encouraging you as the listeners to ponder the essence of melody, rhythm, and harmony. Is music confined to traditional instruments and structured compositions, or can it be found in the symphony of the natural world? "Ocean Lullaby" invites you to explore these questions as you listen.

This piece of audio can serve as a soothing backdrop for various activities or moments of reflection. Whether you're looking for a serene soundscape to enhance relaxation & meditation, or simply looking for a calming ambience while working, reading, or unwinding for the day, "Ocean Lullaby" can provide that for you. The gentle ebb and flow of ocean waves, coupled with layers of field recordings, can transport you to the coastal states of Florida, Georgia, and South Carolina, allowing you to find peace and focus amidst the chaos of our modern lives. 

With "Ocean Lullaby", you're invited to experience the allure of the ocean's embrace and embark on a contemplative journey that transcends the boundaries of sound. It's not just a song; it's an invitation to join me in redefining the very essence of music itself.

records.title: Greatness Indeed
records.creator: 0x7E7c752adA07e3D7d2a6f2B9Ca3C43ce29629881
records.note:
The Beaver Jam Club is the musicians' collective focused on cutting edge music production, founded by Brandon Schroeder. What began as an interview on the Beaver Jam Club's Artist Spotlight show, episode #4 on Twitter (X) Spaces, now available on podcast streaming platforms, blossomed into a creative friendship. Brandon had a vision to create a song based on the amazing freestyle Rohan did with the infamous loop "I Got 5 On It." The song envisioned was to be inspired by the tougher, true-to-life golden era hip hop classics contrasted by the spirit-filled, melodious vocals of reggae music. Brandon teamed up with his brother Ryan and they created the music heard on the track today. Ryan Schroeder is an amazingly talented musician and was crucial in the genesis of this track with Brandon. The song was then sent to Rohan with the help of his manager @$MoneyLoooong$ on Twitter (X). Vocals were recorded by RDG at G.L.O.W. Entertainment studios in North Carolina, US in July, 2023. When finished with many electrifying takes, the recordings were sent to @MerkleyMusic on Twitter (X) with Christopher Merkley for the mixing and mastering. The final production was done between everyone involved including: Brandon Schroeder, Ryan Schroeder, Rohan Da Great, and Christopher Merkley, however none of the production for this song could have been done without the genius of Christopher Merkley's mixing abilities. Brandon is honored to have been able to work with so many truly talented artists to bring this vision to fruition. By minting this song, "Greatness Indeed," you support independent musicians who strive to survive in a world that doesn't appreciate them nearly to the extent it use to. Streaming platforms are nearly impossible to make a decent living on alone and the expectations for what a new album release can bring-in financially are marginal compared to the amounts seen just a couple decades ago. Now with the advent of blockchain tech and smart contracts, the power can be given back to the music creators as opposed to the hand's of big business. A new landscape is being built on the revolutionary minds of web3 devs, paving the way with unique and exciting ways to connect, grow, and remain independent as a musician.

The values of web3 align with Rohan Da Great's mission to support independent music and the culture of music NFTs is what inspired him to get involved, support other artists, and begin creating in this space. This is far from a one time venture for Rohan

records.title: Baltimore
records.creator: 0x1F59f78A84c03f61b3d3c29ba3CD7137909e6257
records.note:
- I moved to Nashville in 2016 with my girlfriend I'd been with for 4 years. She got a job as an E.R. nurse, I came to pursue music. We moved into a two-bedroom apartment together and life was great. I was chasing my dreams and lived with the woman that I planned on spending my life with. After a few years without having any real success as an artist/songwriter, she asked me one day after a long stressful shift at the hospital, "How long are you going to chase this for?" I answered "as long as it takes"... which was and still is my truth.
- After that conversation everything changed. She changed. She wanted security, and I wasn't it. Our relationship started to suffer. That's when Baltimore called. She got offered a 3 month travel nursing assignment to move to Baltimore. She would be able to pay off her student loans and it would also give us a little space, maybe just what we needed.
- A few weeks later she packed up her car, gave me a kiss goodbye, and headed off to Baltimore. Little did I know that it would be the last time we would kiss, and the last time I would see her. After she got there, she didn't answer my texts or calls. Our relationship was over. It became clear that she had made her decision to end our relationship before she left Nashville and that maybe this was the most pain-free way of doing it. I was heartbroken, she was my first true love and it hurt to lose her. I wanted to hate her for it, but I couldn't. This life I have chosen as a troubadour is not for everyone, and It just wasn't for her. I wanted her to find happiness, even if it wasn't with me... and that is what inspired this song, "Baltimore"
- For anyone who has ever been with someone who left them without warning... I present to you... "Baltimore".

records.title: Midnight Cumbia
records.creator: 0x9Ff820A0BA1E7B87c6656E6Dd50F967cC684b15C
records.note:
This song took more than a decade to manifest. This song's surrealistic lyrics and haunting verse melodies were born from a whiskey-fueled dream about a non-sensical conversation in a dark western bar after an ordinary night out in 2010. Luckily, the dreamer woke up with enough sense to realize the potential of this little dream diddy and immediately recorded what he remembered into his iPhone while in bed. Initial drafts of a fuller song with a chorus and bridge were soon written and recorded in the hopes of something sticking, but nothing ever did. Frustrated, the dreamer dropped the diddy and moved on with life...

Fast forward ten years later, and the dreamer woke again from a dream, floating among white, snow-capped mountains with a curious melody blaring in the sky. It was a dream that felt vaguely familiar. Drifting back into consciousness, the dreamer realized it was the continuation of that conversation from that dark Western bar. It was the same dream -- only a proper chorus was born this time. La Cita jams on this concept soon and then ensues, where the song is fully fleshed out and elevated into its current form. 

Like most things, finding meaning, connecting the dots, and looking forward are hardly natural. Sometimes, a dream doesn't end when you wake up; sometimes, it takes more than 10 years to complete a feeling. But looking back, this song is heavily influenced by a love of Spaghetti Western movies and dancing to cumbia music in dark bars. It honors the slow, mysterious, and often aimless character arc from a good Western we go through before seeing things more clearly from a higher vantage point. And yet it leaves room for the mystery and longing that often remain...

records.title: VOID - Golden Egg
records.creator: 0x85AAffc1F91cD828C82D5d0006B38C34b05917e9
records.note:
Inspired by a moment of frustration and realized exhaustion, "VOID" came to be as commentary on how it feels to be an independent artist in a digital world. It's no longer about talent or vision, but how loud you are and how many friends you have. Yet, where does that leave the introverted, quiet types who have something to say - the ones who look and sound different from what's popular? 

Heavy, grungy, and matter of fact, "VOID" is about the underdogs, the ones who work themselves to the bone and throw it all into the blackhole called the internet, time after time. Not because they have to, but because they refuse to live a life that consistently reminds them to give up and fall in line.

records.note:
Quiddity is inspired by Clive Barker's book "The Great and Secret Show." 
In the book quiddity can be accessed only 3 times in someone's life: when we sleep outside our mother's womb for the first time, when we sleep beside the one person we truly love for the first time, as well as the last time we sleep before we die. 

I've tried to encapsulate this into song.

records.title: Somewhere Far Away - Golden Egg
records.creator: 0xB85b4E847fCa8C46a697AF921732Dbd306Ef93a1
records.note:
Somewhere Far Away is an emotional, bass heavy, dark electronic pop song about depression, and inner turmoil.  

The lyrics of this song spilled out of me at 2am one night in a moment of pain and sadness.  I am just grateful to be able to channel this pain into art...

When we have depression or intense moments of sadness, we sometimes feel like we want to run away from everything.  Life can feel overwhelming, and like the only escape is leaving everyone, and everything we know behind.  

Somewhere Far Away is about the impossible dream of running away to a place where everything magically feels better. 

No one knows what it’s like to be you, or be in your mind.  No matter how easy you life might seem, if you’re up at night having panic attacks, or suffering from any mental illness it can be hard to live even the cushiest, most blessed life.

records.title: On My Way
records.creator: 0x1105F52b534FAF048Cf5b35Ab2bF1B302b9d57D2
records.note:

records.title: METAL ON MY TEETH
records.creator: 0x3554cF19951677625eF80c3426F80B1E44f8CC37
records.note:
When I was 10, my family and I took a flight from Zimbabwe to New Zealand. In a lot of ways that was their escape from a collapsing economy, to a new world and yet gripping on to the traditions of the world we once knew. We all remember our first great escape, ironically that was not mine. My escape was writing... An escape from a crashing of cultures that I couldn't seem to confront internally. Spending every second I could get in words and in worlds rather than inwards. That was before I understood that essentially they must co-exist. For one can only travel so far from their flesh before it yearns for water. 

The METAL ON MY TEETH bio below is written as if I am studying my own creative process from outside looking in.  

"METAL ON MY TEETH" is the first single off TAPZ GALLANTINO’s debut album, “ALL FOR WHAT” arriving when the stars align. The Zimbabwe native fuses his punk rock and R&B background to form his unique brand of PUNK R&B. 

Written, produced, and performed by TAPZ GALLANTINO, he brings his trademark grit and spitfire lyricism to “METAL ON MY TEETH” – a thundering foot stomper of a sonic experience with an adrenaline-boosting chorus that chants “They don’t make them like us no more...” 

The track documents his quest for peace in a world that has offered him little to none. Referencing his collective experiences as a black nomad, exploring the combination of political tension and black culture, he sings “I put metal on my teeth, it’s the only time I feel inner peace, smiling. Because the piece that they’re serving in these streets is the type to leave no peace.” TAPZ further explains, “I spent my youth predominantly in an internal culture clash, moving from Zimbabwe when I was ten to the first world created that internal complex. Rock n Roll and Hip hop culture served as an escape, the TV screen playing Jimi Hendrix and Lil Wayne was my mirror. Silver Metal Grills are poetic for me. To me they serve as the right of passage to the first metal you choose to bite, especially in a world of limited choice where we’re forced to bite or even worse – swallow the bullet.”

records.title: DOWN
records.creator: 0x98B05c3895EADe417aD39e80E516b979DFf99682
records.note: "DOWN" is an enchanting, Alternative Afropop song that takes listeners on a heartfelt journey through my personal experience of falling deeply in love with an extraordinary woman. With a captivating melody and infectious rhythm, the song beautifully captures the essence of a romantic summer day. Its multilingual lyrics, blending English, Swahili, French, and Zarma, add a touch of global enchantment, while the poetic expressions celebrate the allure of a beautiful girl's independence and unwavering work ethic. Through this song, I share how her magnetic qualities not only draw me in, but also inspire me to pursue my dreams and win her heart.

'Pressure' is a summer jam i wrote a few months back.
It is a song that is super catchy and easy to sing along with.

I often get inspiration from real situations when i write my music. 

When writing 'Pressure' i wanted it to be less 'Serious or deep' and 
more of an easy listen summer 'smash' but still following the afro feeling it gives especially with the drums and with me being from South Africa it was super important for me to get that feeling out of 'Pressure' the feeling of home if you may. 

My friend was going through a situation and called me mid studio session telling me about how much 'Pressure' he is feeling being with this girl and how he never really wanted it to be a serious situation and that is kind of a brief summary of where the title for the record comes from.

"Escalator" Takes Listeners on an Elevating Journey of Self-Discovery and Empowerment

In the wake of his emotionally charged hit "Valerie," Ayotemi returns with a captivating new single, "Escalator," that serves as a musical balm to heal the wounds of heartbreak. This vibrant track represents a significant turning point for the artist, embracing tranquility and self-empowerment as he rediscovers his purpose.

"Escalator" is a rhythmic masterpiece that effortlessly combines Ayotemi's infectious Indigo Rap flow, skillful cadences, and an irresistible blend of singing and rapping. The song's upbeat nature, coupled with its lush harmonies, creates a sonic landscape that beckons listeners to surrender to its contagious energy.

With a deep understanding of the human experience, Ayotemi's lyrics speak to the transformative power of choosing peace and prioritizing self-care. In a world that often demands conformity, "Escalator" encourages its audience to fearlessly rearrange their lives for the better, embracing vulnerability as a catalyst for growth and personal evolution.

The song's soaring melodies and rhythmic hooks envelop the listener in a sense of high-frequency peace, joy, and the irresistible urge to dance. Through Ayotemi's heartfelt delivery and thought-provoking lyrics, "Escalator" becomes a conduit for catharsis, allowing listeners to recognize the areas in their lives that require healing and transformation.

From the opening notes to the infectious chorus, "Escalator" takes us on a journey from turmoil to serenity, encapsulating the journey of post-breakup introspection. Ayotemi's talent for crafting compelling narratives shines through as he seamlessly weaves together personal anecdotes and universal themes, creating an empathetic connection with his audience.

As Ayotemi returns to his purpose, "Escalator" serves as a powerful reminder that choosing self is a courageous act, and that we all have the capacity to rise above our past experiences. With its vibrant energy and uplifting message, this track positions Ayotemi as a beacon of hope and a guiding light for anyone navigating their own path towards personal growth and self-discovery.

"Escalator" is more than just a song; it's an invitation to embrace vulnerability, rearrange the pieces of our lives, and find peace in the process. Ayotemi's artistic prowess shines brightly, offering an enchanting musical experience that resonates on a profound level with listeners.

records.title: Every Day
records.creator: 0x497A7dEE2f13DB161eb2fEc060Fa783Cb041419F
records.note:
Every day is a battle and a struggle whether its mental, physical, spiritual, or emotional. This song was created to battle every day struggles and let the people know they are not alone, we are not alone in our battles even if it feels like it. 

This song takes inspiration from Citizen Cope's "Let The Drummer Kick". I created a simple and easy to remember chorus that's vague enough to insert ones own problems into and identify with. The verses touch on different aspects of the everyday struggle and I almost abruptly ended the song at 4:20 because life is unpredictable like that and because I'm a stoner and Mary always helps. 

Light one up and relax because its all gonna be okay, we'll all make it to our destination on time and intact.

records.creator: 0x967DdbA67d15f07A4a6f77E2721CFfdb6bc744CF
records.note:
"I'm direct in my quest. Am I correct in my guess?"

My Quest is about the confusion I have had about the journey I am on. I wrote this song in 2019, during a confusing time in my life. I was at university and realized after years of being an engineering major that I didn't like engineering. I spent years working towards something I wasn't sure about. But, even when I wasn't sure it was still working hard. Direct. But was I sure that this is what I'm supposed to be doing? Will this lead me to the life I'm supposed to be living? Or even want to? I'm not sure. Perhaps only time will tell.

records.title: JOY

'JOY' a beautiful song that probably means the most to me.
I lost my uncle a few weeks go and the day i found out i went to studio and found myself writing this record with no intention of doing anything with it besides sending to friends and family and most importantly for listening to it myself to heal and feel the emotions of the ups and downs of losing someone. 

Uncle Ken was my mothers brother in law who was married to her oldest sister 'JOY' who passed away from cancer when i was very young.

So for me the title means more than the word  'JOY' 
& when writing this i had the feeling that i was talking to my uncle and asking him questions about Life,Love and meaning. 

So the feedback i have gotten from friends and family has pushed me to share 
'JOY' to all of you and i hope a few of you can relate to this special first song i have decided to share with yall.

I know he is happy with his 'JOY' in heaven.

records.title: Sent By the Man
records.creator: 0xB158572Fc732Ab7F4b3616871840726abC6A8015
records.note:
“If you really want to be famous, change your name to Sky Bravo.”

He looked me dead in the eye as he sat up and grabbed my arm, his seriousness taking me aback. The whole scene really. His eyes a bit cold. His large and ever-commanding frame, frailed by time.

He was on his deathbed and we both knew it. 

There were times when we didn’t know what to do - when I didn’t know what to do - except sit. Except think that a young man ought to be near his grandfather during his final days on earth. 

He was not a vulnerable man, Paw Paw. Charming, yes, a smile that could melt your heart or bend your will *just so* whether you were part of the family or had just met. But vulnerable, no.

So when he looked at me - as he broke the silence that we had been sitting in for hours that turned into days that turned into weeks that turned into the passing of a generation - when he looked at me and broke that silence - to tell me a quip that crossed his mind or why he thought Nicholas Cage was great in Raising Arizona - every bit of small talk was like - have i spent my whole life really not getting to know you? not asking a single question beyond what i could see? and when he broke the silence…

“I coulda been a singer.”

Stunned, having been lost in my own world, contemplating the silence and sitting and sitting and - stunned.

“But you were, Paw Paw, you *are*.” My heart careful not to place his life in the past tense. “You have a gold medal in singing - in chorus competition - the barbershop society - a gold medal -“ my voice raising in pitch as my heartbeat quickened, pleading to the moment, “the quartets - your quartet - the spellbinders - you were a singer, you ARE - “

“No.” 

He interrupted deeply, but kindly. 

Stolidly, with his full self, he spoke again.

“Like Sinatra.” 

So matter-of-fact.

He lay back - his strong-broad-frail shoulders lay back as the life he imagined flashed before my eyes - the crowds lost in ecstasy swaying in unison, the dancing lights reflecting through the sweat dripping from the brows of the great entertainer, the bathed in gold, the showing up to play your role, the diamonds, the sparkling eyes, the grit and glamour of a public life.

Once more from the silence:

“If you really want to be famous, change your name to Sky Bravo.”

records.title: helloworld - no matter how this ends i'll be just fine
records.collection: helloworld - no matter how this ends i'll be just fine
records.creator: 0x284Ce068C22eEf2518CA3EdF8aF09a682bbFb674
records.note:
“no matter how this ends i’ll be just fine” is the final track on my EP “things i wanna text u” - a look into my life during one of the biggest heartbreaks I’ve ever experienced. A point that brought me to the lowest point in my mental health I have experienced. The song serves as a reminder to myself, mostly, that no matter how this ends, I’ll be just fine.

But, I didn’t always believe that. I remember clearly one point in the heat of it all where I genuinely questioned if it would be okay. I hadn’t ever experienced that before. I was genuinely concerned about my mental health for the first time ever.

Through this experience, I learned how important it is to take mental health seriously. i learned so much through this journey and want to use this music to help others who are going through something similar. To show them they’re not alone.

That’s why, through this drop, I am donating half of the proceeds to Bring Change To Mind - an organization that is helping to make a change and end the stigma around mental health and mental illness. If you’re struggling, you’re not alone, and I’m here for you.

records.title: show me
records.creator: 0x12bd2aACA914786E322e8e20181BE2877e8F098B
records.note: “show me” was a really fun song to make, and the creative process from start to finish was unlike anything I had made before. When I first made this track, what is now the verse was actually the “drop” or the main hook, the song was much slower, and I had written and recorded my own vocals on it. It was a cool track, but I knew it could be better (i'm not a very good singer). That's when I decided to send the instrumental to a songwriter and vocalist, with no instruction other than to “have fun with it” and see what she could do. I absolutely loved what she sent back and I ended up making two different new versions of the song. I made one version with the original drop and her new vocals layered over the top, which made a sort of Nu Disco Indie-Electronic track. The second version I made was a high-energy bass house drop that used all of the ad libs she recorded and some bouncy bass lines I had written underneath them. In the end, I took both ideas and was able to mold them into one track to get the best of both worlds, and that's the tune you hear today. Hope you enjoy dancing to this one as much as I did making it! see you soon. - informal.

records.title: Status Online
records.creator: 0xEc8A41a11Dd7c2CD18eB3352E45861E242Fca63A
records.note:
This song started the way many others do, with my friends throwing different ideas around with no expectations or guidelines. Collaboration is such an integral part of my process. Gaining an outside perspective and playing off of each others strengths always leads to a unique product, as opposed to sometimes getting stuck in a loop when creating on your own. 

The beat for this song first came to life in March 2022. I pulled up to the Wallis Lane HQ in Santa Monica to have a session with Don’t Trip, an extremely talented producer duo I had been working with for over a year at that point. It was maybe our 3rd or 4th idea that we made that session. They started laying down some melodies and adding layers but it really came together when they played that bright, abrasive, synth bass over everything. I believe every song should have elements that cut through the rest; ones that are instantly recognizable, and this was it. After they got that down I immediately had ideas for the drums. I was picturing driving hats and a huge snare, reminiscent of a lot of 80s/Synthwave drums. I did my best to translate everything in my head onto the track and added some toms and other percussion to really solidify the movement of it. 

After this session, the beat went into a folder for 4 months until I had a session with Kevin George in June. I didn't even send the beat out before that because I wasn't sure who I could hear on it, but I knew Kevin was always down to hear the weird, left-field beats on my hard drive, so I played it for him. As I was playing it I think the same elements that stuck out to me, stuck out to him. He told me to put it aside and later that week I saw he posted an Instagram snippet of what he had recorded. Once I heard the hook I new it was special. 

The song laid dormant for almost a year after that, until I was texting Kevin trying to figure out which song of ours I should release for my debut in Web3 and he reminded me that we still had 'Status Online' in the vault. After getting the vocal stems from him and tweaking the instrumental and arrangement, the song was finally ready for people to hear. In my opinion, one of the best parts of producing is looking back and seeing the journey an idea took from its inception all the way to its release. It really makes me appreciate the process and the care it takes to showcase a song to the world. I'm excited to continue to drop music on this platform and give y'all a chance to invest in this journey! Much l

records.title: Relics
records.creator: 0x0717604B3B44b661408e187cB11F3Dc313480621
records.note:
My name is Toha and this is the story behind my solo genesis, ‘Relics’

This track was birthed a few months back when TK the Legend and Kits.IO released The Eternal Garden Master Collection sample pack. https://www.kits.io/packs/eternal-garden-master-collection

I started browsing it and the loop featured in his song ‘Pain’ instantly grabbed my attention. I let my Intuition guide the writing process and before I knew it, I had a finished track on my hands. 

At the time I was meditating on relics.
Relics can be categorized as souvenirs with deep historical or personal value- often creating feelings of nostalgia or a reminder of experiences lost to the hands of time. Relics can also hold spiritual power and be used as a tool to strengthen or protect the holder.

The artwork features Suyat, an ancient writing script from the Philippines. Historically it was written on leaves and wood, but also carved into artifacts like pottery or jewelry. Using this script alongside the artwork is my way of re-imagining the relic as something that can live on-chain forever. Learning to write Suyat empowers me and I hope to share that feeling through the song and artwork.

My vision for this release is to inspire new people to have fun participating in a Sound.xyz drop

In the spirit of that, I have a few rewards:

All collectors will be airdropped an animated version of the cover art (via L2) (Golden Egg will also have its own special animation)

All collectors additionally can reach out to me directly and have their name written in Suyat 📝

I've also created a physical relic- a framed mixed-media version of the cover art. It will be rewarded to whoever has the most referrals/or videos using the song at the end of the mint period. 

Let’s share this moment together. 'Relics' is a seed for the future, and I’m grateful for your participation 💎

records.title: A Child's Memoir
records.creator: 0xb9C18A66A45ee459ECFfB7fEB44b32665230d677
records.note:
Usually, the idea of what the song will be about comes to me during the process of writing the music.

While experimenting with distortion, I heard a familiar timbre from my childhood. I remembered how I spent a lot of time at my grandmother's playing with her old electronics. There were radios, TV remotes, flashlights, and so on.
I was most interested in the radio; I didn't understand what it was, but I really liked the various buttons and the antenna. One day, I turned on the radio and heard white noise. I was surprised that it still worked. I was very happy with my discovery! Turning the knobs, I finally found a station with music. On that day, I spent a lot of time listening to music and the voices of announcers on that radio. The distortions were uniquely pleasant, simultaneously beautiful and dirty.

I tried to transfer those feelings to the present, to modern sound. Here, there is that distinctive distortion, curiosity, admiration, and innocent childlike simplicity.

Enjoy listening!

records.title: "Just Off In Our Own World"
records.creator: 0x26eF03A20AaeDA8aaFCeE4E146DC6B328195947C
records.note:
"Just Off In Our Own World" - Produced By Dutchyyy

As someone who grew up & started their music career in the mid 90's (Golden Era / Boom Bap HipHop) I've had a large portion of my long term supporters as well as new listeners stumbling on my earlier works who adore and wish I would keep creating music of the same style from those early years. This pertains to Beats (Dutchyyy) & (Rhymes) 

I went into detail about this in much greater context recently, which if you care to understand you should read thru all the descriptions and backstories here:

+ https://beta.catalog.works/dutchmassive
+ https://beta.catalog.works/dutchyyy  

Reality is, from the very beginning I've always been making music that didn't fit into any specific genre since I don't just listen or draw inspiration from a single genre.  While most of my music is rooted in the fundamentals of traditional hip hop / beat making.  I've always gravitated towards creating instrumentals that can speak for me, that aren't meant for people to put vocals over. Just genuine self expression minus the pressures of how that art will be received by others.

This external pressure reached an all time high 2012-2014 with supporters getting frustrated I wasn't releasing new music rapping, and even more so that the Instrumentals I were releasing, weren't your typical hip hop beats (sidenote: funny years later my style would become a whole genre, branded "Lofi-HipHop")  

After moving from Los Angeles, back to Tampa Bay and then Immediately to NY in 2014, I reunited with my pops after over a decade of having no communication.  

You can read more about this Arc of my life here:

https://medium.com/@SolarSounds/shawangunk-stomp-the-story-of-dutchyyys-uproot-4235a4eb66ff

Long Story Short,

My Pop's saw the pressure fans were putting on me and how I was torn between trying to please strangers and wanting to escape the boxes I was always being shoved in and told me that since I was a child, I always marched to the beat of my own drum and never cared what anyone else thought, a trait I inherited from both of Parents as we are all a tad "out there" he told me to ignore all the outside noise and let go, Because the view is better and much more rewarding when truly existing "Off In Our Own World"

MELVV steps into lead vocals on "I'll Be There for You" for the first time in his career. Drawing mainly upon inspiration from Porter Robinson and Madeon, the track features sparkling arpeggios, a lush vocoder, and smashed drums; an introspective and emotional anthem with ear-worms throughout.

records.title: Rise
records.creator: 0x25381D1A348aD6448D9368B455026231b6e262FE
records.note:
I’m Upper Reality, producer and artist, and I have been developing myself for 10 years.  As a longtime creator, I have grown and changed immensely and watched the industry do the same.  “Rise,” is a reimagining of the exhilaration, appreciation, joy, pain, and ultimately, exhaustion, that I have garnered following this life path.

I have an Economics degree from the University of Texas at Austin.  I used to not mention it, because it didn’t seem “cool,” but the more I traversed my journey, the more I began to see how cliques, identities, buzzwords, and other superficial considerations go into valuation of a person and what they do.  This understanding has led me to have a more active, intellectual role in my work, just in time for the intersection of music and fintech to make a place for it.  There is a sociological and spiritual revolution happening with my work that I seek for all listeners to feel and understand when they listen to what I’m creating.  This is all my production, all my music theory understanding, all my vocal training, all my Ableton practice, and all of the closed doors that have never recognized what I have felt to be a gift that I have.  See, “Rise,” is not just about a vacant, toxic-positive chant to peace and love—it is a proverbial snatching of the goalpost—a declaration of “sleep on me, I’ll sleep on you,” to all of the times that I have had my core wounds invoked by organizations, groups, systems, and people, that I wanted to value me, accept me, etc. only to be rejected, humiliated, abandoned for superficial reasons, yet told it’s something that I’m lacking.  “Rise” says “Nope, I was never the problem.  And now, with the joys I reach on my own terms, you all will see that, from afar.”

I am at a point of detachment to the outcome, as to whether or not I will be heard, recognized, celebrated, or valued.  As of now, this is just a special piece, that means a lot to me, and means a lot that the Sound audience would be keen to listen.  I enjoy the piece very deeply, but I have left it in it’s raw, early stages, before tweaking it to see whether DSP’s will bite. So this is a special, limited edition, that won’t be released anywhere else.

For more information of the entire context of what I’m wanting to do in Web3, please check out my proposal video:

https://youtu.be/Xxp1Y8iKaI8

Darby and I had been discussing the healing journey, and how someone (or something) can leave a void in your life after they're gone. This echo can't be moved on from until you confront your past. Sonically, we wanted this track to be layered with texture and ambience, and have chords that gave you the feeling of that emotional tug of war. records.title: Don't Take Your Love
records.creator: 0xDD6529c9e2275153f230d7F03e975893B0B235b4
records.note:
"Don't Take Your Love" was released on May 22, 2020, roughly two months after "15 days to slow the spread". It was my last release of 2020 and my final solo/pop track before fully entering the EDM space in 2021. 

The song first came to life while I was messing with a vocal plugin I recently purchased and experimenting with stacking a lot of vocals together to make a choir/gang vocal. The line that started that experiment was, "No, don't take your love from me." 

The lyrics were inspired by a relationship on the verge of collapse, and the feelings of experiencing someone's love slowly fade. It's interesting and kind of poetic, though, that the song lyrics are beautifully and tragically paralleled with the love of the world gradually being replaced by fear. So I'd say "Don't Take Your Love" is also a song about the desperate plea to not lose love in the world during one of the most extraordinary times of our lives. 

"Don't Take Your Love" is one of the few songs in my career that is 100% written, recorded, produced, mixed, and mastered entirely by myself. This style of song is the kind of music I want to return to making in the future. 

This Music NFT release with Sound is a brand new endeavor for me in the Web3 space, so a massive thank you to them for reaching out and another huge thank you to everyone who mints this song. 

From the bottom of my heart, it really does mean the world to me when anyone finds a connection with something I've created. 

Much Love and God bless, 

Zack Gray

records.title: Rosa Linn “Hallelujah” R3hab Remix

records.note:
Nvak Collective is a next-generation record label and artist advocacy collective that fully embraces web3 to uplift creators. Our mission is to build a more equitable, profitable, and diverse music industry that puts the underrepresented first, recognizing that the current system is in need of major disruption. Our small team has already discovered talent from remote regions around the globe and launched them to billions of streams and hundreds of thousands of fans, all while providing artist-friendly deals and artist care. 

With a focus on signing and developing women, non-binary, and LGBTQ+ artists from emerging markets, we see web3 as a tool to better help these creators tell their stories, earn new revenue streams, and connect with their biggest fans. Since June of 2022, we’ve worked hard to bring rising artists such as Annika Rose into the web3 space, and will continue to bridge the gap in web3 education and onboarding for artists seeking to take the leap.

Rosa Linn began her journey with Nvak Collective back in 2018 when she was discovered by Nvak’s local A&Rs at a small music festival in Dilijan, Armenia. She became the first artist signed to Nvak Collective in 2020, and has since surpassed over 1 billion streams and will be opening up tours for Ed Sheeran, Young the Giant & Milky Chance this summer 2023.

Rosa’s latest single “Hallelujah” puts her powerful vocals on full display as an ode to the life-changing year she has experienced since competing at Eurovision for Armenia and signing a major label deal. She says, “This past year, my life has changed so much. It can be hard to put into words how grateful I feel, but I hope this song helps you understand.” This “Hallelujah” R3hab Remix offers a dancier twist to the already uplifting track, and we’re excited for it to be the first of many curated drops from Nvak Collective. Play it loud.

records.title: Freedom Bass
records.creator: 0xca7250Ea76A0bf90bdd709d0Bcd743D43Ad18f39
records.note:
In honor of Pride Month “Freedom Bass” is a celebration of the radical and connective power of dance music. A disco-house track and call-to-arms for the queer and dance communities alike. 

A nostalgic, yet forward-thinking track, “Freedom Bass” a lyrical call to action for resistance and change set against a mashup of disco and 90’s house. Written during the pandemic, in the heart of lockdown, the song is filled with melancholy and a desire to return to the dance floor, surrounded by joyful crowds and uninhibited self-expression. 

“Freedom Bass was the first song that we ever wrote together in the basement of Boy Untitled's LA home during quarantine. This was long before we decided to become a boy band (lol) and like most first sessions, we were just feeling each other out to see if we would catch a vibe. We put the track down only to return to it a year later. Little did we know that this would become the thesis of BOY2K: 'The dance floor is the revolution...this is Music For The People.' Our mission as artists is to create spaces for people to come back "home" to. Spaces to find ourselves. Spaces to connect. Space to riot against systems of oppressions. Spaces to imagine the new world that we want to create together."

BOY2K’s mission is to make “Music For The People,” that is, music that celebrates the power of community. A community built in mutual support, love, acceptance and music that begs the listener to get up and move!

Learn more about BOY2K at www.boy2k.com.

records.title: MINIMUM WAGE
records.creator: 0xA29510a6d6de5F05659d1683A5D01A8E392c264a
records.note: Minimum wage is about the day that I understood that he bare minimum of absolutely anything is simply not going to cut it anymore (wage, love, time, loyalty, energy, you name it). This record was born in my writing sanctuary, the castle in Bordeaux, France, in a writing camp with 3 incredible producers. It is an anthem of all of our early twenties, a time stamp of my many day jobs - selling printer ink to the US army, assistant to an interior designer, party planning, waiting tables, singing at steak houses to empty rooms, you name it. This song is an ode of gratitude and respect to those choices in the pursuit of the dream - running to sessions and rehearsals after an 8-hour minimum wage paying work day. It is also a farewell to hustling for anything that is not the gift of music. This song is part of the "Queen George" chapter of my music that will include my recent releases.

records.note:
When we think about “Chaos Theory” the first thing that comes to mind is control. We think about how all of us navigate the world looking for a little semblance of control in this chaotic world we live in. We want to believe that we somehow have an external reach beyond us that protects us, that guides us, that gives us the power over our lives that we are looking for…maybe we do. Maybe the music and the art, the creativity, the words, maybe that’s how we exercise control in this chaotic world. It is our little mark, we own it. We didn’t go seeking the name “Chaos Theory” it found us, all we did is control what we could control and that was the creation. We kept coming back to that river and drinking from it, slowly carving out a space for something bigger than both of us.

- Daktyl & Benni Ola

records.title: CUFFED
records.creator: 0xd68892aEd5b3a9B1E419B8a2C0D2c6A9C17d7679
records.note:
“CUFFED”  - one of the four singles leading up to my sophomore album “ANGEL OF SADNESS”, self produced and written by me. The whole project is a set of love songs, not only to people but to my head and heart. 

In light of May being mental health awareness month, CUFFED is the love child of whacky, whimsical sounds and . . . ha ha . . . severe mental illness :’) living with mental illness has been a painful life, especially with a diagnosis including the most stigmatized and misunderstood disorders, and it is something I am aiming to be more open/vocal about. I’ve been in a never ending battle trying to get better with treatment centers, psychiatrists, therapists, and medication cocktails for as long as I can remember, and falling back in not only love with a partner but with creating music again after a production hiatus has taken every ounce of mental jiu jitsu possible for someone like me!! however, I’ve never felt more creatively liberated than I do now that my brain is set on the right path and in recovery, and this project truly celebrates getting out of the artistic rut I’ve been in for so many years. 

mixed with my wonderful partner in crime, who also inspired this project, rob <3 (peep our duo project GLOWSTONE if you haven’t)

records.title: Babydoll
records.creator: 0x7A8B510E2c7424936392d298409d0E6908b933d7
records.note:
Uffie is the project of the globe-trotting artist and fashion icon Anna-Catherine Hartley, formerly signed to Ed Banger Records, where she became acquainted with legendary producers of the early 2000s French electronic music scene. Her career spanned many successes including her first viral hit song called “Pop The Glock,” which was originally posted on MySpace and launched her fame in the Bloghouse era of dance music. She collaborated with the French electronic duo Justice on “TThhEe PPaARRtTYY,” which appeared on their Grammy nominated album Cross in 2007. Her debut album, Sex Dreams and Denim Jeans, was nominated at the French Victoires de la Musique for Best Electronic Album in 2010. She has since collaborated with Pharrell Williams, Charli XCX, Galantis, and Mr. Oizo, to name a few. 

Uffie returned in 2018 with her debut single “Drugs” from her EP Tokyo Love Hotel. A muse to the art world, she collaborated with Jam Sutton in 2019 on a marble statue and A.I. experience, accompanied by her track “Ego.” She is currently writing for other artists, with credits including Pink, Khalid, Greyson Chance, Blu DeTiger, VINCINT, and Tegan & Sara. Her sophomore full-length, Sunshine Factory, was executive produced by Toro y Moi and released last spring on his label Company Records. You can hear her writing and vocals featured on The Blessed Madonna’s comeback single this past November titled “Serotonin Moonbeams.”  

For Uffie’s first official NFT drop, she chose to bring one of her favorite unreleased songs to life. “Babydoll” was created with longtime collaborators Lokoy and Veronika Jane Wyman (of DAGR). What began as a poem on a calm quiet morning, ended as a ketamine-inspired freestyle. Enjoy the ride.

records.title: Answers
records.creator: 0x5F36B2AD2C0CcaFb2c46ad689b277b110724b3D5
records.note:
ANSWERS
Pt. 5/5 (Answers EP)

‘Answers’ came to me unexpectedly one summer morning at 2 am. I was in a trance, playing the chords repeatedly until the lyrics seemed to write themselves. It felt like the words were given to me before I fully understood them. At that time, I had been reflecting on the idea that our reality could be part of a grand experiment, a giant holographic pulse. Everything I was reading and listening to seemed to hint at this concept. The purpose being to disconnect us from the truth of who we are, through the limitations of the human body, societal programming, and cycles of suffering, to see if we remember. But what do we remember? I believe the answer can never be expressed in words. It's a felt sense that we all glimpse from time to time. At the deepest level, I think we have all, at a soul level, agreed to be part of this game, not to seek escape, but to fully immerse ourselves in every facet of it, knowing that it is, in fact, just a game.

records.title: LITTLE DID I KNOW
records.creator: 0x4d18f8f2aE19f1E166c97793cceeb70680A2b6D2
records.note:
This sing was inspired and created out of a very cool and humbling moment around a year ago.

My first song, CHILDHOOD, the first song on sound.xyz, was purchased on the secondary market by @CR41GD (on twitter) for around 8 eth (or exactly that). It was the highest secondary at the time, and although I only received 10% royalties, it marked a very significant moment for me. That my art is valued outside of just me creating it. It was strange and surreal, but incredibly humbling to feel such love for my art.

I had told Craig that I would make a song dedicated to the moment and include the feelings I felt at that time. Although times change, and this moment is filled with stresses and obstacles, it is nice to look back at that moment and know that times like that will come again.

Thank you all very much.

records.title: Higher

records.note: Planet Zuzy’s debut single “Higher” is an ode to her global upbringing and love of eurodance music. The single was first born while Zuzy was away in Spain, overlooking the North African coast, she pulled out her laptop and recorded the captivating melody that drives the track today. She finished the track a few months later, and was ready to release it. One day she re-opened the session, and ended up turning the original trance version, into a classic Avicii inspired mainstage tune. The tracks ended up being so different, but complimentative of one another that Zuzy decided to release both versions. Higher is the epitome of what Planet Zuzy stands for, diversity in sound and euphoric melodies that make you feel like you’re flying.

records.note:
Who are Beachcrimes? We’re a duo from LA and we spent the last year making songs in hotel rooms around the world. Beachcrimes is the soundtrack to that adventure.
 
We made a lot of songs, and we’re excited to share them. All of them. This year we’re releasing 24 songs in 48 weeks. If we’re being real, it’s actually two albums – there’s AM and there’s PM. AM is the lite stuff, PM is the nite stuff. Think of it like the Summer Olympics and Winter Olympics, but for dance music.

"Summer" is our 9th release this year, paying homage to the dance music legend Calvin Harris and his hit song that has soundtracked our summers for a decade. We thought it needed a true PM version. Deep melodic techno? Don’t mind if we do.

Next single will be out 2 weeks from today, and the following single 2 weeks after that.

records.title: Pray To Me
records.creator: 0xe4DCED7280DE1Bb29C98B81cf87536fe95e86526
records.note:
Pray To Me is our sound.xyz genesis and with all the conversation regarding AI as it pertains to music, we thought it was a great place to start. 

The song features AI GRIMES vocals. Grimes is one of our favorite artists and thanks to her forward thinking idea, we were able to collaborate in a new and profound way. 

The conversation about AI has been an interesting one, and as artists we wanted to embrace this new tool and see how it could be used in a tasteful way that doesn’t compromise the music but still pushes the boundaries of what’s possible musically.

Lyrically, ‘Pray To Me’ is casting a spell on an old lover. And no matter how hard they try to escape the feeling of being with you—be it other lovers or drugs—they are always drawn to your presence and the intense moments of passion you once shared together. 

Sonically, we were inspired by old industrial and post punk records as well as 2000’s pop ala Brittany Spears & Lady Gaga. We wrote the song on an acoustic guitar with Avalon Lurks and moved into production from there. The drums are a roland TR-8s drum machine run through a guitar amp for some extra sludge. The live bass is a vintage p-bass played through a Peavey guitar amp with a warbly chorus effect. The synth bass is an acid patch we made on a Moog Little Fatty. The guitar is a vintage hollow body Tiesco played direct through a Neve and effected in the box. We made the vocoder patch on a microkorg and recorded through a Peavey guitar amp. For the vocals we used Uberduck AI and all of the post processing was done in the box. 

The artwork was made using adobe photoshop, a xerox machine, a razor blaze and some scotch tape. Also, the golden egg incorporates a special humanized piece using GRIMES’ Chaos manual.

We feel confident that we were able to blend the hyper futuristic with organic human textures to create something that couldn’t otherwise exist. A symbiosis. Technological and biological harmony. Humachine. Leave a comment and let us know what you think. Love.

i wrote this one last year in LA - at the time i was stuck in an endless cycle of arguments with someone i was seeing, and eventually realized the easiest way through was to just apologize for a bunch of things i didn’t do.

records.title: Jump Ship

records.note:
Jump ship is the first release from the illusive Groggy Jones under Ollie Chanin’s Stone Face Records. Capturing Groggy’ ethereal style and earthly influence, Jump ship is message in a bottle from Groggy to his lost love waiting for him on his home planet. Combining jazz and R&B with electro soul, Groggy’s Yxesosian roots make for an unforgettable sound that leaves the listener feeling deeply harmonious with the universe.

Groggy Jones is a musician and producer from the planet Yxesos, where music is an integral part of daily and spiritual life. Groggy's love for music was amplified when he discovered Earth's diverse range of genres through his cosmic radio. Driven to experience it firsthand, Groggy used the forbidden "tempo tether" to travel through space and time, landing in New York City. Due to the lack of harmony on Earth, he is unable to use the “tempo-tether” to return home. After being stuck on Earth for 32 years, feeling defeated and hopeless, Groggy meets Ollie Chanin, who reignites his hope and encourages him to reach for the stars.

records.title: baby i love you <3
records.creator: 0x6644762282a12CE9e71271FC4d0a9ef412a04caE
records.note:
In the Summer / Fall of last year, I toured with She Wants Revenge, playing 40 shows across the US. My set up on stage was a synthesizer, electric guitar, drum machine and vocal effect box. It was a challenge, to bring my songs to the live stage on my own, as most of the music I had recorded with other musicians. But when I saw the audience reaction to what I was doing live, I realized that this was more satisfying than anything I had done before. I love making electronic music and having the autonomy to play it all on my own. 

For “baby I love you <3” I asked my girlfriend to say something into my phone. She said “baby I love you.” Without thinking too much, I imported this sound file into my computer and within a few hours I had the song that you hear now. I had been struggling previously to figure out how to include my love of techno / house and DJing into my music that was otherwise relatively acoustic. But the more time I put into my own production, with just my computer and a keyboard, the more confident I am about this new direction and the more excited I am to make more electronic music.

Ultimately, this song isn’t tryna do too much. It’s just fun and feels good. I hope you love it.

The MSFT Kit pack is a collection of audio samples created by MSFT and one of the first NFT music sample packs, designed to be used by music producers and artists. By using these samples, Vivid Fever Dreams was able to create a unique and innovative sound that sets "Gone Away" apart from other electronic music tracks. Overall, "Gone Away" is a testament to Vivid Fever Dreams' talent and ability to create powerful and meaningful music that resonates with listeners on a deep level.

Artist and producer bloody white offers an otherworldly musing in his new song, “SOMETHING OF AN ARTIST” for HIGH FREQUENCY Volume 1. The hypnotizing, gentle lull of the track conjures a daydream—like playing a grand piano on a hot summer day in the countryside a la Call Me By Your Name. It’s romantic, beautiful, and full of angst. Seeking a breakthrough, bloody white turned to the piano.

records.title: Get Mine (acoustic)
records.creator: 0x5567C85CBbe24c65C80783b520ea538552f47A88
records.note:
In early 2021 I regained control over my publishing from Universal Music, created my first blockchain music project, and never looked back. 

The nearly 2 decades prior to this pivot were a long, strange trip through creative innovation that began when I won the inaugural YouTube Award for Best Music Video for my song “Say It’s Possible.” I went on to release my first album with Universal Music Publishing and Island Records followed by a string of independent releases, and toured for the majority of the next decade, playing everywhere from Wembley Stadium and historic opera houses across Italy to smokey pubs and people’s living rooms. It was a wild ride to say the least. 

I struggled to make ends meet, in spite of licensing dozens of songs to film and television and touring all over the US and Europe. I tried just about every crowd funding platform, including Pledge Music, Indiegogo and Patreon. The concept of “turning your biggest fans into your marketing team” felt inherently flawed without any real incentive for listeners to spend their valuable time promoting my music. 

And then, in 2020, I discovered the nascent tools of web3 and was filled with a renewed sense of hope – the framework was finally in place to create a mutually beneficial relationship between artist and fan. 

In the process of creating my own audiovisual NFT projects, I discovered a passion for guiding and advising at all levels of interest and experience, from the web3 curious to blockchain natives, creatives to executives. 

I became an advisor to Async Art and led Community, Marketing, and Strategic Partnerships for Authentic Artists' WVRPS by WarpSound which remains the number one music collection on OpenSea since its launch in January 2021. I helped launch Async Art’s “Blueprints” tool with collections by top crypto artists XCOPY, Coldie and Alotta Money, as well as generative code artist Kenny Vaden’s collections with OpenSea, Flamingo DAO, and Quantum Art. I joined XPRIZE as web3 Lead, helping to pioneer groundbreaking use cases for blockchain technology in fundraising and philanthropy. 

And now it’s time to funnel some of my creative energy back into my own art. 

“Get Mine” is a reflection on being an artist in the crypto space, a commentary on the late stage capitalist world we inhabit, a reflection on the experience of meeting my own shadow. 

It’s a deeply personal song that I hope will resonate with so many of us in this space and I hope you love it. 

Thank you for rea

records.title: God Universe Magic (G.U.M) Ft. SATE
records.creator: 0x3F1BE0E1813fD6C4f054f40f73D3b14d77e99aE5
records.note:
God Universe Magic (G.U.M) ft. SATE and produced by my wife and business partner SUN SUN is the last song off of my newly released 3rd studio album titled ‘Gateway Experience’.
I wrote G.U.M as a mantra for myself to repeat to feel powerful and in control of my life, even though I’m dealing with health issues that leave me feeling powerless. Every song on this album speaks on my symptoms dealing with focal aware seizures, so I thought it was important to end it with a spell of empowerment.
The title of my album is an ode to the released CIA report ‘Gateway Process’ where they studied the use of sound tapes to manipulate brain waves with a goal of creating altered states. Examples include out of body experiences, remote viewing, psychic abilities, the ability to heal one's body and so much more. Join me as I question the connections with our brains, music, dreams, seizures, god and otherworldly abilities.
G.U.M features sampled parts of an interview I did with fellow Toronto based artist SATE where I asked her about her belief in God/magic/other. And where she spoke intimately about her own mother - the late, great Salome Bey’s struggles with seizures.
The cover art photography, along with the eyeglasses I’m wearing was created by my wife and producer SUN SUN.

records.note: The second official WesGhost release "Haunted House" is a continuation of my story through the sounds inside my head. I’ve always loved scary movies as a kid & I often wondered why the world- myself included- is so fascinated by terrifying things. records.title: What's it all for?
records.creator: 0x90513c9caA617706AD46bc7f886787B5736f2FC8
records.note:
The modern person’s internal questionnaire:
what’s it all for?
am i doing the most?
compared to everybody else?
can i… ?
will i… ?
what if… ?
the 
list
goes
on
and 
on 
and
on…

Too often do we get stuck in this cycle, lost in it’s feedback until our thoughts become a piercing hiss. Is searching for something that matters comparatively to societies expectations of happiness, success, beauty, freedom, etc. “healthy”? How can we re-examine our internal dialogue to project a “healthier” reality that may have been there all along? 

Sure, making music is a form of therapy to help cope with these questions; providing a space for ourselves to explore without boundaries or judgement. Furthermore, sharing that music can allow it’s listener to sort through some existential questions of there own. Divert a crisis perhaps, gain a new perspective, reach for forgiveness instead of anger, or simply alleviate life’s struggles for 3 brief minutes. Enjoy! 


Written, Produced, Mixed, & Mastered by NBF at our studio at the legendary Sound City Center in Van Nuys, CA.

records.title: Waterwings [Decade Rework]
records.creator: 0x92526B99715AFeEd324Fb56EcAFcac8056379300
records.note:
The first album I ever released under the name Dot came out ten years ago in 2013. The 14-track instrumental project was titled "Evolve or Dissolve," and looking back over the last decade of music I've created, it was a great name to kick off a catalog of work that constantly changed and evolved with every new song I wrote, place I moved to, friend I made or job I worked. 

While this album is coming down off of streaming services soon (it really feels like student work to me at this point), it was important for me to honor the ten-year anniversary of this release by minting one of my favorite instrumentals from the project and having it permanently live on the blockchain. 

Before the official release, I posted "Waterwings" as an instrumental on my SoundCloud page, and it was one of the very first beats I had ever created in Ableton (I started learning production in Reason a few months prior to this). Shortly after, I received a DM about the track from an A&R who was looking for instrumentals for this up and coming artist named SZA. Solána wrote and recorded vocals, and the song eventually made it on to her first EP titled See.SZA.Run. Her career exploded shortly after, and it's been incredible to follow her progression as an artist over the last 10 years. 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9ndpl6Wfzcc&ab_channel=AnteBabic
https://soundcloud.com/justsza/sets/see-sza-run-ep

Even though I don't feel as confident about my production skills from those early days, I'm still incredibly grateful and blessed to have created music with an artist who I look up to so much, during a time when both of us were just finding our footing in the music world. Creating music back then always felt so pure and free, and it's a feeling I constantly search for to this day. 

I'm honored to share this 2023 rework / remaster of the instrumental ten years later, and I really hope you enjoy the music <3

Emily Lazar is a multi-disciplinary artist fronting the rock/metal transmedia project, September Mourning, who made history as the first female metal/ hard rock musician to mint and sell an NFT. September Mourning is a transmedia project based on a comic book series she wrote and published through Image/Top Cow Comics with her business partner Marc Silvestri (Batman/Witchblade/Darkness). September Mourning is the title character. As a human reaper hybrid, she  gives expired souls a second chance at life in another body. In doing so, she messes with  the plans of the antagonist, Fate, who is trying to rid  earth of all the good souls and leave the bad so the world will self-destruct and It can start anew. An epic war between the living and the dead ensues. Emily plays the title character on stage.

Emily designed the world she and her band (Rich Juzwick, Kyle Mayer and Aaron Hoover) bring to life on stage, including costumes, choreography, sets, etc. The band has toured with & opened festivals for Rob Zombie, Marilyn Manson, Slipknot, Mudvayne and others across Europe and the United States.

"Dirty" is an in your face, heavy hitting, percussive, driven, epic, hard rock/ metal track that speaks to anyone who has ever felt f*cked over by someone else. The track has a push and pull in the music, lyrics and vocals that follow the pulse of the marching drums in the choruses.

We go by the name Levity, a Chicago based electronic trio known for happy music full of colorful synths, upbeat drums, and euphoric soundscapes all wrapped into one. Our goal is to bring back and innovate that 2014-2017 “future bass” sound that’s both easy to listen to/connect with, and slap live. 

Paradise was our first ever original release back in 2020. Prior to that we had only done unofficial remix’s for Soundcloud. This song started as a remix using one of our friend’s (Kolla) vocal in our member John’s childhood bedroom in November of 2019. Maybe a month later we got asked by Electric Hawk Records (Up and coming record label focused on artists receiving 100% of royalties) if we had anything we could release with them for their upcoming compilation “Rebirth”. We sent them this song (at the time titled “With You remix”) and they loved it but needed it to be original and due a month later. After little luck of finding singers we took to twitter asking for recommendations and that’s how we found LINDZ, who wrote and recorded her vocals remotely! 

“The nostalgia of being at my childhood home with my family had me excited and happy which drove the inspiration for this song. The production for the verse really felt like a warm homecoming where you could let go of any problems and worries and bask in the joyous presence of being with the ones you loved. LINDZ took that feeling and nailed it by bringing that feeling to a warm summer day with someone you love.” - John Hauldren (1/3 of Levity)

X Li, an independent alternative music artist from Los Angeles, known for previous collaborations with major companies such as Sony Music Entertainment, Dolby Laboratories, and ByteDance, has now ventured into the web3 space with his latest project, "california love stories".

"california love stories" is a collection of love stories set in different parts of California that capture a range of emotions, including sadness, heartbreak, joy, tragedy, anger, and longing. The project is produced by a team of renowned music producers, including platinum record producer James Chul Rim, known for his work on over 4 billion streams and TikTok chart-topping single "Wait a Minute!". The project also features a talented lineup of musicians, including Simone Sello, known for his work as the lead guitarist for Italian rock icon Vasco Rossi, and Edoardo Tancredi, a seasoned musician who has performed on Jimmy Kimmel Live and collaborated with artists like Avril Lavigne and Amelia Moore.

The project's sound quality is attributed to the talents of Lukas Cuman, who has worked with artists such as Ed Sheeran, Bebe Rexha, and Ultimo, and Gavin Lurssen, a highly decorated sound engineer with 12 Grammy nominations and 4 wins. Lurssen has worked on numerous film soundtracks, including those for Game of Thrones, The Mandalorian, Mulan, Captain Marvel, Black Panther, The Hunger Games, and Westworld.

To capture the essence of the music stories in "california love stories," we have chosen a simplistic art style created by New York-based artist Farrah Fisher. It’s a powerful thing to be both CREATOR and the CREATED!  I’ve always known that “Art is meant to comfort the disturbed and disturb the comfortable. To be disruptive is not always a negative thing. With a super bloom ahead of us, I went to visit the Poppy Fields. I noticed fields of orange poppies plastered across miles of land with a few purple and white peeking through. I laughed and said “Well it makes for a powerful picture” 

I can't remember a time when music was not the focal point of my life. The soundtrack to every memory, the anchor for every family gathering and the calling that I couldn't escape if I tried.{Insert “Big Dummy”}. Growing up in Brooklyn, New York in a Jamaican-American household to a musical family meant Church was 6 days a week.I started singing at 2 years old, writing poetry at 11, recording songs at 13 and an Emmy and a Grammy later I am still finding new things to love about my craft. An artist has to create ART. It's a life force. Indie artists do it broke, tired, scared, unsupported and anxious most of the time.  

The act of creating is a harnessing of power. Every time we invalidate the power of music and devalue its contribution to the world or its impact on our lives, we are literally eroding the thread that weaves through everyone on the planet. Music is universal! It connects us to the source of all that there is. 
It's a responsibility! Black women know all too well how divinity and power gets subdued, disrespected and cast aside. Honoring your artistry, teaches you to engage in the greatest surrender and the responsibility of honoring your own power!

I wrote this song as a way to pay homage to the ways that music has transformed my life, and that surrendering to what felt like the unknown brought me to the closest point of home
We are nothing without music. We are nothing without God(dess).

We exchange with each other because there's nothing like a room, stadium, or crowd full of people on the same frequency. That's power! records.title: We're Not Going to Die
records.creator: 0x077Fe9e96Aa9b20Bd36F1C6290f54F8717C5674E
records.note:
We're not going to die from AI. 

Back in February 2023, Eliezer Yudokowsky painted a chilling and grim picture of a future where AI ultimately kills us all. Robin is here to provide a different perspective. He explains why he believes Eliezer is wrong. It’s not all sunshine and rainbows though — we might just become their pets instead. 

Most importantly, Robin highlights his concerns about AI regulation and why he believes it's a greater threat than AI itself.

This is the counter-argument to Eliezer’s infamous episode “We’re all going to die”. 

Artwork generated from the quote [51:48 - 52:22] “One of the most striking features of our world is the mechanisms we use to keep that peace and coordinate among those divergent and conflicting things. And one of the moves that often AI people often make is to assume that AIs have none of that. AIs do not need to coordinate. They do not have conflicts between them. They don’t have internal conflicts. They don’t have any issues on how to organize and how to keep the peace between them. None of that is a problem for AIs, by assumption. They are just these other things that have no such problems. And of course that leads to scenarios like they kill us all. 

10% of proceeds go to Bankless DAO.

records.title: Get Up
records.creator: 0x070925F3F3050DF0a88F8C7837560BC99939D248
records.note:
"Get Up" is a 2020 single from Custom Model. The song wrong was written and produced specifically for a DJs4CA (DJs for Climate Action) livestream early on in the pandemic. Following the performance of the song, there was an overwhelmingly positive response, which led to fast tracking the release on traditional DSPs.

After around two years on DSPs, Custom Model was solicited by a sync agent wanting to shop the song around to music supervisors. Without much consideration, a verbal agreement was made to see what kind of sync market existed for the song. Fast forward about six months, and the sync agent found a Netflix original series called "ELITE" that wants the song for their upcoming season. 

Now we are all caught up... almost. The show is apparently a big hit around the world, and people started streaming "Get Up" like crazy. Just recently "Get Up" has passed 20,000 streams on Spotify, and to celebrate it is being minted on the blockchain as an open edition.

Custom Model Genesis Crew Members get early access and pricing. Collectors of Chíc Bangs also get early access. A special airdrop related to "Get Up" is being prepared for those who mint in the presale window.

records.note:
The second set of 10 sonic vignettes from my album "Old Friends New Cities" is a collaboration with Ukrainian movement artist, Rudo. The first time I saw Rudo dance online I was awestruck by his totally original style of movement – it was flowing, angular and raw.

In late 2022, Rudo arrived in Berlin from Kiev, and we immediately began a series of collaborations.

What you're seeing is the first fruit of those collaborations. Set against a backdrop of Brutalist architecture, we captured Rudo moving improvisationally to the music of "Old Friends New Cities", and then curated the most impactful fragments into bite-sized infini-loops. There is no post production done beyond reversing Rudo's organic freestyle.

I hope you'll enjoy it,
-dessauer

records.title: Elevator
records.creator: 0xE76fE6c105b7973ac758e77C7fFE35eB1F473344
records.note:
Who are Beachcrimes? We’re a duo from LA and we spent the last year making songs in hotel rooms around the world. Beachcrimes is the soundtrack to that adventure.

We made a lot of songs, and we’re excited to share them. All of them. This year we’re releasing 24 songs in 48 weeks. If we’re being real, it’s actually two albums – there’s AM and there’s PM. AM is the lite stuff, PM is the nite stuff. Think of it like the Summer Olympics and Winter Olympics, but for dance music.

"Elevator" is the 7th wonder of the Beachcrimes world. This tech-house banger has PM written all over it. Believe it or not, this baby was born in a hotel elevator perched on the stunning cliffs of the Amalfi Coast. As we ascended from sea level to the hotel lobby - a cool 1000 feet high - we were beatboxing and humming "Elevator, straight to the top" into our voice memos. A few hours later, it was a fully-fledged song. How's that for an elevator pitch?

records.creator: 0xF180F7c066C9Af638b73CEEF139D5AdDE0D4265F
records.note:
ABOUT THE RELEASE:

Welcome to the Fever Dream sessions.

The songs from this session have an energy that came from being pent up and isolated for over a year during lockdown, to being around each other again and playing music in the same room. And it wasn't just any room either, our friend Darrell Thorp invited us to record this 3-track session in the gorgeous rooms at The Village in LA.

After an anxious year of pandemics, covid variants, personal health scares, and all the other bad juju the quarantine era brought, this session was a perfect oasis to break the anxiety that had built up since the lockdown began.

That's why the joyous energy had us buzzing. How cool was it to be around each other again, playing music with the best people, in the best place? Hopefully, some of that good vibe comes through in the music, and that the songs will help release the feverish anxiety into joyous catharsis.

Track 2 of 3: Year of Self (Fever Dream Version)

This version is a hazy redux of our first single ever "Year of Self", a celebration of anyone with courage to live earnestly outside the box, not out of rebellion, but out of coming into your own and knowing that's the way you want to live it. The song is also an ode to astronomer Galileo, who was persecuted and ostracized for pursuing his mode of thinking, leading many  to consider him the father of scientific thinking.

records.note:
We’re excited to bring this incredibly special song to Web3 as our first MusicNFT drop on the Sound platform and the songs first ever release on any platform. 
‘Wrong Hands’ is about a dysfunctional mother daughter relationship and the damaging effects that can have. The cycle of love, hope, disappointment, loss, anger and despair (repeat). Two people reaching out for each other in their own way but never quite being able to sync up. It was produced in Nashville by grammy winning producer Femke and mixed by grammy winning mix engineer Michael Brauer - famous for his work mxing 'Parachutes' by Coldplay and 'Continuum' by John Mayer among countless other iconic songs and albums. 
This NFT offers a unique opportunity to pick up a real treasure and join our growing community of music fans at a pivotal time for our growth. We host a monthly Zoom hang concert for our holders as well as sharing behind the scenes content in our holders only chat group.

About Belle Mt.
Belle Mt. are a 3-piece indie Alt-Pop band from London, UK fronted by Singer and Songwriter Matt Belmont, with Ben Worsley on Lead Guitar and Chris Burgess on Drums. Their cinematic, ethereal but driven sound is rooted in deeply crafted insightful lyrics and infectious melodies. They have amassed a devoted fanbase with over 60 million streams across platforms since their debut EP release in March 2018, receiving top tier play-listing across platforms including on New Music Friday in multiple countries and two top 40 US alt radio releases (Hollow in 2020 and Famous Son 2021).

Their most recent live shows include tour supports for RAG’N’BONE MAN, KALEO, LARKINS & JUANES (with sell out shows at London’s Hammersmith Apollo and Shepherds Bush Empire). 
Returning with an April 2023 headline show and an evolved sound; Belle Mt. have been collecting serious momentum and attest that their upcoming debut album constitutes a watershed moment, their best work yet.

records.title: endless sky
records.creator: 0x17c72771bB6B283baDe0C07E0901744C37Ff8c41
records.note:
This is a tune I started while staying in an Airstream trailer in the woods of central California, channeling my inner Bon Iver. I spent 5 days out there making music and hiking all day. Drank a lot of instant coffee as well.

I recorded probably 30 demos in that trailer and I've been chipping away at them ever since. Whenever I get stuck or at a loss for new ideas, I crack open one of those projects and I can still feel the palpable sense of inspiration I had on that trip. 

The core foundation of this song is a sample of an old song my friend and I made about 10 years ago. I used some granular synthesis to make a bed from that old track, then structured a new song around the sample. As I often do I recorded my voice then mangled it up to make some emotive vocal chops. 

I'm hoping this one takes you on a nice little mental trip -- you deserve it ✨
